'''Kunoa''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kunoa can be found both on [[Vaiken Spacedock]] and in [[Kaas City]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
